bugs.title: Super Series - one AI response plans an ENTIRE series at once; tool renders each part sequentially as a queue of ordinary Stage B jobs
bugs.notes: FEATURE-01 IMPLEMENTED. Design decisions recorded per contract: (1) super_series flag persisted INSIDE the existing series block of stage-a-request.json (series.super_series) — fits §7.1 conventions, needs no schema migration. (2) Toggle UX decision: Super Series is a SEPARATE Settings default (set:superseries screen, branding/super_series_settings.json, mirroring the Series Mode default); it is FORCE-DISABLED at the startJob commit boundary whenever Series Mode is off, so the flags can never desync (chosen over disabling the toggle, so a mid-wizard Series-Mode flip is still safe). (3) Super-plan schema = top-level {version, series_id, video_duration_seconds, target_total_duration_seconds, parts[]} where each part is an ordinary §7.3 production plan; validator enforces shared series_id, contiguous tiling from 0, exactly one is_final and it must be last, unique titles, MAX_PARTS=20, and full per-part §7.3 validation via the existing validator with a positional part_number override. (4) Verified before trusting: pipeline/plan/series.py derive_next_part has ZERO live callers (only its own tests) — confirmed dead code; the queue controller synthesizes requests via bot-side nextPartRequestBody/nextPartJobId/manualSeriesContinuation-adjacent helpers exactly as the spec required. (5) Completion detection reuses the bot's EXISTING per-minute cron sweep (scheduled() → runSuperQueueSweep, same mechanism as bug-51 clone sweep); durable state at jobs/<anchor>/super-plan.json; spawned part marked spawned BEFORE dispatch so a crashed tick never double-dispatches. (6) Halt-and-resume: first non-complete spawned part decides; error/cancelled → operator notified ONCE per part via ordinary bot message pointing at the existing task:restartb flow; complete → next part auto-queued; no separate resume trigger. (7) Restart path reused verbatim: restartStageB (existing). Publishing untouched — spawned jobs are ordinary jobs, so the stage-b.yml automatic Zernio dispatch fires identically. (8) Each spawned part passes the UNMODIFIED series cross-check: synthesized request carries the part's own correct series_id/part/start_seconds and the sliced plan's series block is re-stamped positionally, so reconcile_series_metadata sees matching data (zero changes, zero reconciliation needed) — pinned by slice tests asserting validate_production_plan(part, part_number=n) == []. Bot test note: wizard.test.mjs initially failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (tweetnacl) because the sandbox had no node_modules — an environment issue, not a code issue; npm install was run and the suite re-executed (result in the commit message of this checkpoint).
